profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Proficient with Python, Java, SQL, C/ C++, Mathematica, MATLAB, and more!

For fun, I like to test and contribute to games console emulators such as Dolphin (dolphin-emu.org) and Xenia (xenia.jp).

I excelled in my undergrad AI class (4.0) and would like to eventually pursue AI + ML professionally.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Primary teams: Financial Forecasting & Guest Travel Insurance
Developed scalable applications using modern frameworks. 
Maintained and developed extremely large-scale computational analysis pipelines.
Spearheaded team initiatives on meeting precise technical requirements.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to align software solutions with business goals. 
Optimized existing codebases to enhance performance, reduce latency, and meet industry best practice standards. 
Participated in code review and deployment within mature CI/CD frameworks.
Commanded rapid incident response, including no-fault post-mortem analysis and documentation.
